technique_name: Develop a plan to hide an orange from a mischievous squirrel.
description: Create a squirrel-proof enclosure to hide the orange. Starting by finding a large clear container, preferably made of transparent plastic. Drill small holes in the bottom of the container to allow air to enter, and/or attach a piece of breathable fabric over these holes to allow air to circulate. Next, line the bottom of the container with a thin layer of soil, place the orange in the container, and fill the remaining space with soil.
